values.quote: it is a collection of people or organisms of a particular species living in a geographic area
of a particular species living in a geographic area
there can be between 3 and 200 races in the human population
racial classifications are inadequate descriptors of the distribution of genetic variation in the human species
An alternative to classifying the human species by race is to divide them by ethnicity
Dividing populations along ethnic origins can present some of the same classification issues
